p3g2.instruction: Complete the flowchart below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 34-37 on your answer sheet.
p3g2.body: Flowchart (each stage leads up to the next, ending at ACTIONS). Stage 1: [[34]]: conditioned to react; often influenced by place of birth. Stage 2: BELIEFS: possibly only personally held beliefs, not necessarily universally [[35]]. Stage 3: [[36]]: could lead to complications when reacting to others. Stage 4: ATTITUDES: can be short term and relate to [[37]] at a particular time. Stage 5: ACTIONS: what we opt to either do or not do.
